summary: Sucker Punch's PlayStation-exclusive superhero action-adventure series, covering Cole MacGrath's PS3 games and the PS4-era Second Son/First Light branch.

emulation.notes: Use original PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.

primary.why: Infamous is a PS3-only release and is also included in the PS3 Infamous Collection; PS3 hardware or RPCS3 is the only documented route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 release through RPCS3 if compatible, or original PS3 hardware.

emulation.notes: Use original PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.

primary.why: Infamous 2 is a PS3-only sequel and is also part of the PS3 Infamous Collection.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 release through RPCS3 if compatible, or original PS3 hardware.

emulation.notes: Use original PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.

primary.why: Festival of Blood is a standalone PS3 expansion built from Infamous 2 and does not require the base game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 digital/collection route through RPCS3 or original PS3 hardware.

entries.title: Infamous Collection

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.

primary.why: Infamous Collection bundles Infamous, Infamous 2, and Festival of Blood on PS3, making it the best packaged route for the Cole-era games.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original PS3 hardware or RPCS3 where compatible.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a PS3 compilation, not a remaster beyond the original PS3 versions.

entries.title: Infamous Second Son

primary.why: Second Son is a PS4-exclusive standalone sequel and is playable through PS5 backward compatibility.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4 release on PS5 compatibility or PS4 hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Fresh protagonist/setting; not a direct Cole story continuation except through world history.

entries.title: Infamous First Light

primary.why: First Light is a standalone companion/prequel to Second Son centered on Fetch and does not require Second Son to play.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4 release on PS5 compatibility or PS4 hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Standalone companion, not DLC requiring Second Son.
